lines.name: l1
lines.text: You'd lose your security deposit in a week with these roommates.

lines.name: l2
lines.text: Germany already made a cleaning schedule. It's laminated.

lines.name: l3
lines.text: Italy is cooking pasta at two A.M. and arguing with the stove.

lines.name: l4
lines.text: Japan cleaned the whole bathroom. Nobody saw it happen.

lines.name: l5
lines.text: And Brazil invited forty people. On a Tuesday.

lines.name: l6
lines.text: Which roommate are you? Comment your country.
